content.title: Surveillance Contrast-Enhanced Chest CT
content.rawText: CT Chest: Status post right upper lobectomy. Clean bronchial stump. No evidence of recurrent local soft tissue mass or mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Clear left lung parenchyma. Stable post-surgical appearance.

sections.clinicalSummary: No evidence of local recurrence or distant pulmonary metastasis on post-op CT.
